'''Paul Todd Feldman Feldman's New Sanctuary Deck''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Paul Todd Feldman]], published on [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="torch99">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/sanctuary.html Feldman's Sanctuary!], Torch Industries (Paul Todd Feldman). Preserved copy (22 October 1999): [https://web.archive.org/web/19991022220609/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/sanctuary.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Torch Industries]], 1999
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Clak'dor VII|ANH-L-clakdorvii.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Asteroid Sanctuary
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Feldman LS Sanctuary 1999 Torch.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==
Feldman's Sanctuary deck as posted in October 1999, built around [[Asteroid Sanctuary]] and [[Never Tell Me The Odds]], with Clak'dor VII as the starting location. The source lists 63 cards.<ref name="torch99" />

== Later version ==
Feldman posted an updated Sanctuary deck on the same page in 2000.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20000306172717/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/sanctuary.html Feldman's Sanctuary! (2000 version)], Torch Industries, Internet Archive copy of 6 March 2000.</ref> It started with the [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]] Objective and swapped the generic X-wings and Y-wings for Red and Gold Squadron starships. It also added Rendezvous Point, Rebel Fleet, Lando In Millennium Falcon and The Signal. No decklist is given here because the list as published isn't functional: Hidden Base needs a copy of a system that the deck doesn't include.
